title: Engine-rolled Game skill checks
change: Game Mode skill checks are rolled by the engine instead of written by the GM. The GM asks for a check and the engine rolls every one in the turn (not just the first), applying the player's skill and attribute modifiers from the player's own character sheet found by name (not the first-listed party card), keeping a die the player rolled themselves, and overwriting GM-invented numbers whose arithmetic does not add up. Explicit success pools use engine rolls; unsupported/underspecified systems stay unresolved; a check asking for advantage and disadvantage at once is left alone. An unrollable check is saved as the plain request. The GM requests the roll before guessing an outcome; the engine supplies the result for a follow-up that finishes the turn.
